content_marketing_much_content_marketing.question: How much does content marketing cost?
content_marketing_much_content_marketing.answer: Article packages start around $250 per month for four optimised posts, with pillar pages and multi-cluster programmes quoted by scope. Guest post placements start at $20 depending on the authority and traffic of the host site.

content_marketing_use_ai_write.question: Do you use AI to write the content?
content_marketing_use_ai_write.answer: We use AI for research, clustering and outlining, never for final prose. Every published sentence is human-written and edited, which is why our pages continue to perform through helpful-content updates that flattened bulk-generated sites.

content_marketing_long_should_blog.question: How long should a blog post be?
content_marketing_long_should_blog.answer: Long enough to fully answer the question and no longer. In practice that is 1,200–1,800 words for a focused how-to and 2,500–3,500 for a pillar page. Padding hurts, because it dilutes the passages an answer engine would otherwise extract.

content_marketing_often_should_we.question: How often should we publish?
content_marketing_often_should_we.answer: Four to eight substantial pieces a month builds topical authority at a sensible pace for most businesses. Consistency and internal linking within a cluster matter more than raw output volume.

content_marketing_will_content_help.question: Will content help me appear in ChatGPT answers?
content_marketing_will_content_help.answer: It is the main lever. Language models cite sources that state facts plainly, structure them clearly and are corroborated elsewhere. Answer-first pages plus schema plus consistent brand facts across the web is what moves you into generated answers.

content_marketing_write_industryspecific.question: Do you write in industry-specific niches?
content_marketing_write_industryspecific.answer: Yes — healthcare, SaaS, legal, real estate, education, manufacturing, travel and e-commerce among others. Technical or regulated niches get a subject-matter review round with your team before publication.

content_marketing_who_owns_content.question: Who owns the content?
content_marketing_who_owns_content.answer: You do, fully and permanently, from the moment it is delivered. There are no licensing terms and nothing is reused for another client.

content_marketing_refresh_existing_conte.question: Can you refresh existing content?
content_marketing_refresh_existing_conte.answer: Yes, and it is often the fastest win available. Rewriting existing pages answer-first, adding schema, updating statistics and consolidating cannibalising URLs frequently lifts traffic faster than publishing anything new.

content_marketing_handle_keyword_researc.question: How do you handle keyword research?
content_marketing_handle_keyword_researc.answer: We map keywords by intent — informational, comparison, commercial and transactional — then assign each cluster to a page type so pages do not compete with each other. Paid search data, where available, tells us which terms actually convert.

content_marketing_reporting_i_get.question: What reporting do I get?
content_marketing_reporting_i_get.answer: Monthly reporting covering published pieces, rankings and impressions per target query, conversions attributed to content, and AI-visibility checks showing whether assistants now mention or cite your brand for tracked prompts.
